name: Ẓanna and its sisters
definition: Verbs of thinking, knowing and making that come upon a mubtadaʾ and its khabar and put both in naṣb, as their two objects.
body: Ẓanantu zaydan munṭaliqan: I thought Zayd was leaving. What was a nominal sentence (zaydun munṭaliqun) has become the two objects of the verb.
Al-Ājurrūmiyya names ẓanantu, ḥasibtu, khiltu, zaʿamtu, raʾaytu, ʿalimtu, wajadtu, ittakhadhtu, jaʿaltu and samiʿtu.

examples.text: I imagined ʿAmr was setting out (al-Ājurrūmiyya).
